title: The Love Hypothesis
plot_overview: A biology PhD candidate and a demanding professor enter a fake relationship to solve their romantic dilemmas. What begins as a carefully planned arrangement soon complicates their views on love, forcing both to navigate unexpected feelings and the pressures of academic life.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like light academic romances, opposites-attract chemistry, and fake-dating complications; Not for you if you prefer darker stories or less familiar romantic setups.
review_summary: Pros: playful romantic setup; academic setting; built-in tension | Cons: familiar fake-dating premise; limited review context
